newsitem.title: USA: Package bomb explodes in San Diego girl's hands.
newsitem.headline: Package bomb explodes in San Diego girl's hands.

text.p: A package bomb exploded in a teenage girl's hands on Wednesday outside her home in an affluent San Diego suburb, sending her to the hospital where she was listed in fair condition.
A San Diego Police spokesman said the 14-year-old girl is the daughter of Dr. Gary Losse, a physician for the San Diego Chargers professional football team.

"We received a call from the doctor at 6:48 a.m. PST (9:48 p.m. EDT) this morning, and he said his daughter had opened a package and it just went off," spokesman Bill Robinson said. He could not provide any details about the size of the bomb, to whom it was addressed or whether the family had received any threats.
The girl was immediately taken to Scripps Memorial Hospital La Jolla. A spokeswoman there said she was listed in fair condition but could not provide further details.
Local news agencies reported the girl suffered burns and other injuries to her face and hands.
San Diego's Metro Arson Strike Team is handling the investigation, the police spokesman said.
La Jolla is an affluent suburb just north of San Diego.
